title: Decide and build who acts on a served Tier-0/1 ACTION: line
goal: Open since 2026-09-29 (was in brain-lanes.md). Nothing in the tree parses Tier-0/1 'ACTION: <name> [args]' output: there is no executor, so a Tier-0 hit shows the person the literal text 'ACTION: status'. After reflexes were restricted to direct, model-less user prompts, options are: (a) execute read-only foundational actions (status, version, list_directory <ws>) through the tools plane and return their output with a reflex:* receipt; (b) return the action only to clients that opt in to the ACTION protocol and escalate otherwise; (c) keep as is. (a) makes Tier-0 genuinely useful but touches runtime::reason_internal and MAC policy, so agree the option first. Tests named action_executor_* must prove the chosen behaviour, including that a non-read-only action is never executed.
